run_mujoban_visualizer: run the explore script to visualize the mujoban physical planning game environment in Domain Explorer
run_board_game_visualizer: run the explore script with a board game environment name like go_7x7 to visualize it
create_mujoban_environment: create a Mujoban task with a JumpingBallWithHead walker and MujobanLevel arena wrapped in a composer Environment
launch_viewer_for_environment: launch the DM Control viewer for a Mujoban or board game environment using viewer.launch
load_board_game_environment: load a board game environment like tic_tac_toe_markers_features using board_games.load with functools.partial
